mapper.select: SELECT t.tag_code AS tag_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(t.tag_name), ''), MAX(t.tag_code)) AS tag_name, COUNT(1) AS tag_count FROM t_transfer_object_tag t INNER JOIN t_transfer_object o ON t.transfer_id = o.transfer_id WHERE o.received_at >= #{startInclusive} AND o.received_at < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY t.tag_code ORDER BY tag_count DESC, tag_code ASC
